newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Sberbank leads Russian shares up, new highs seen.
newsitem.headline: Sberbank leads Russian shares up, new highs seen.

text.p: Russian shares leapt to a new record on Wednesday as the price of Russia's biggest bank Sberbank surged and traders forecast a further rise in the stock in the next few days.
The Russian Trading System (RTS) 22-share index, which does not include Sberbank, rose 2.31 percent to 377.69 on $69.42 million in total market volume.
Traders said the repeated records of the last few days were fuelling demand for shares and large orders in place would keep the market growing at new high levels.
"A positive mood is reigning on the market starting with the LUKoil LKOH.RTS rise and finishing with Mosenergo MSNG.RTS," UFG trader Igor Vain said.
Dealers rapidly revised their estimates of resistance for Sberbank, which has already doubled in price this month.
"Sberbank SBER.RTS shares were working miracles today and I think it will be even higher. Yesterday we thought the resistance level for the paper was $250, now I think $300 quite possible."
Sberbank ordinaries closed at $257.0, down from their mid-day highs of $285.0, but up from $242.5 at Tuesday's close.
"Sberbank is such a powerful structure that even taken current capitalisation, it does not seem too expensive," a Western company trader said.
LUKoil ordinaries edged up to $16.80 from $16.20, power utility Mosenergo was $1.373 after $1.304 and power utility Irkutskenergo IRGZ.RTS rose to $0.3230 from $0.3014.
Traders said profit-taking, seen in the last several days was receding, and this was spurring a further rise on a market full of unfulfilled orders.
"Profit taking fell at recent levels and there was nothing to do but to buy," the Western trader said. "Besides, big orders are open which will be executed at prices higher than the market."
Traders said they saw most interest in leading shares, while oil holdings were most popular among less liquid paper.
NK Surgutneftegaz was traded at $370-$380 after $330 on Monday, Vostochnaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya was $1.0 after $0.80-$0.85.
"If leading shares edge up some more, second-tier shares will start rising, too," the Western trader said. "But really we are at a stage where the blue chips are rising."
